topic: The Great Pyramid's precision — and the gaps in the record

beats.narration: The Great Pyramid is aligned to true north within a fraction of a degree.
beats.image_prompt: Great Pyramid of Giza at dawn, golden light, vast desert, cinematic wide shot, dramatic sky, no people

beats.narration: Built more than 4,500 years ago, it contains roughly 2.3 million stone blocks, some weighing over 40 tons.
beats.image_prompt: massive ancient limestone blocks stacked in a pyramid structure, close-up texture of weathered stone, warm desert light, no people

beats.narration: How the heaviest stones were raised is still not fully settled — ramps, levers, and internal systems are all proposed.
beats.image_prompt: artistic reconstruction of ancient Egyptian construction ramps beside a rising pyramid, soft documentary light, no people

beats.narration: What is clear: the builders left almost no written explanation of the method.
beats.image_prompt: empty desert plateau with the Giza pyramids in silhouette under stars, contemplative night sky, cinematic, no people
